query:
SELECT 
  ac.id AS client_id,
  ac.email,
  ac.name,
  ac.is_active,
  COUNT(cq.id) AS total_quotas,
  GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(cq.id, '|v', cq.vessel_id, '|#', cq.quota_number, '|', cq.quota_type, '|active=', cq.is_active) SEPARATOR ', ') AS quotas_detail
FROM allowed_clients ac
LEFT JOIN client_quotas cq ON cq.client_id = ac.id
GROUP BY ac.id, ac.email, ac.name, ac.is_active
ORDER BY ac.id;
